title: Silicon Valley Doesn't Get Why You Hate AI
summary: But other recent polling data shows that people have broader anxieties about the technology that go far beyond jobs and the data center boom. Earlier this month, Zuckerberg published a 6,500-word essay painting his optimistic vision of an AI future.
